subject: Signature freeze windows & evidence backfill — MAP alignment
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@novagen.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP & signature freeze proposal

Karthik / Laura –

Thanks again for the demo last week. We reviewed internally and want to move fast but we have one ask around timing: our legal ops team is implementing a "signature freeze" window for the month of November (staff training + vendor audit) which could block final signatures if we don't land before Nov 20.

High level asks from Novagen:
- Can Redwood provide a mutual action plan (MAP) that sequences MSA -> DPA -> Order Form and clearly shows evidence delivery dates (SOC2 attestation + encryption details)?
- Would you accept a short-form commitment to sign the MSA by Nov 18 if SOC2 evidence is shared and DPA/order form are in final draft? Novagen can do a 30-day evidence backfill if needed, but we need contractual commitments to preserve budget.

If you can share a MAP spreadsheet and a recommended sequencing (which item we need to finalize first to unblock procurement), that will help our procurement and legal coordinate internally.

Attaching NOVAGEN_Security_ASKS.pdf (summary) — will follow up with Priya Shah from Legal.

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Novagen Therapeutics

--
Attachment: NOVAGEN_Security_ASKS.pdf (summary stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@novagen.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & signature freeze proposal

Alex —

Appreciate the clarity. I pushed a quick draft MAP and sequencing spreadsheet (MAP_timeline_v2.xlsx) into the thread for you and Priya. High-level proposal from Redwood: 

Option A (fast path) — if Novagen can accept a conditional sign of the MSA by Nov 18 we can:
  - Lock MSA terms now (no outstanding commercial redlines)
  - Finalize DPA language in parallel (target Nov 18 sign)
  - Order Form (pricing and term sheet) gets executed on DocuSign within 48 hours of MSA sign
  - SOC2 evidence: provide SOC2 summary and control matrix by Nov 18; full report or bridge letter within 30 days after signature

Option B (standard path) — staggered:
  - Finalize DPA first (legal to legal review, target Nov 25)
  - MSA executed after DPA (target Dec 2)
  - Order Form follows (Dec 3–7)

Key dependencies we flagged in the attached MAP_timeline_v2.xlsx:
- Procurement requires either completed DPA or an acceptable DPA redline tracker visible in HubSpot to enter the final approval queue.
- If Novagen needs to sign before the full SOC2, we can accept a SOC2 bridge letter + summary controls and commit to deliver the full report within 30 days.

I've added a DocuSign envelope (DocuSign_MSA_v3.pdf) placeholder in the spreadsheet. If you want to pursue Option A we'll set the DocuSign envelope to route automatically to your legal once we lock final terms.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether Novagen will accept a conditional MSA sign (Option A).
2) If yes, share Priya's preferred DPA redline deadline and any procurement hold dates (you mentioned a freeze).

I'll be on the road Tue–Wed but reachable by email.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

--

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & signature freeze proposal

Looping in procurement constraints — quick notes for Novagen and Redwood: 

- Our procurement calendar: any contract needing financial approval after Nov 19 will be queued and not processed until Dec 1 due to year-end close prep on our side. That means Nov 18 signature is tight but workable if the DPA redlines are resolved before signature.
- We require the DPA to be in a finalized state for the procurement system to create the purchase order (even if the PO references the MSA number). If Novagen signs MSA first, we need a DPA redline tracker shared to Procurement by EOD Nov 16.
- For SOC2: procurement will accept a SOC2 bridge letter + SOC2 control matrix for initial approval, but the full SOC2 report must land within 30 days of PO issuance.

Proposed sequencing (we should mirror in the MAP spreadsheet):
1) Legal alignment: exchange final DPA redlines (target Nov 12–16)
2) Procurement readiness: create PO template once DPA is in final comment state (target Nov 16)
3) Conditional MSA sign: Nov 18 if (a) DPA redline tracker shared, (b) SOC2 bridge + matrix provided
4) Order form & PO issuance: immediate upon MSA sign (Nov 18–20)

Marissa — can you flag any finance gating items we missed?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Karthik / Laura —

Thanks — Novagen is prepared to run Option A with a few clarifications: 
1) We will sign the MSA by Nov 18 if Redwood confirms that the Order Form pricing is final and DocuSign envelope is ready for routing to our CFO immediately after MSA sign.
2) We will provide DPA redlines by Nov 12 and need Redwood legal to acknowledge receipt and provide a redline tracker by Nov 14.
3) SOC2: we can produce a SOC2 bridge letter + control matrix by Nov 16; full report to follow within 30 days.

If Redwood agrees to those specific dates we will prioritize signature before your stated procurement queue blocks us.

One ask from our side: please add a single-row fallback in the MAP that states: "If DPA redline tracker not provided by Nov 14, then signature window reverts to Dec 2" — that gives our execs clarity on the consequence.

We agree to the attached MAP_timeline_v2.xlsx with the fallback row added. Please send the DocuSign link when you’ve uploaded the final MSA.

Best,
Alex Torres
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Novagen Therapeutics
